title: The Stars with Rhonda: The Bus Is Not Coming
description: Rhonda forecasts each sign's small commute catastrophe as serene cosmic fact. Ronnie panics and keeps trying to spin a delayed bus into good news.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And now, the stars. <p:0.3> With Rhonda. Travel edition.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Gemini. You arrive at the stop four minutes early. This is the last good decision you make. <p:0.3> The bus is not coming.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Whoa, hey, four minutes early, that's a win. Maybe it's just running a little late?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Capricorn. Your shortcut becomes everyone's shortcut. You taught them. Now there is no shortcut, only you and your regret in lane two.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, lane two, that's a low point, I'll give you that.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Sagittarius. You ask the driver if this is the express. He does not answer. He has not answered anyone since the fog. <p:0.3> The bus is not coming.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It came once though. The bus. Historically. It was, like, on a route.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: It was never on the route. It stopped running in nineteen ninety-one. <p:0.3> And it can see you waving.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Give me one good sign for the road, Rhonda. One. The commuters need a little hope.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Your sign, Ronnie. <p:0.3> You are the one still standing at the stop, waving at a bus that stopped running in nineteen ninety-one.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: [question-en] I... I'm not even waving. <p:0.3> Why am I waving?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: And it can see you. <p:0.3> The bus is not coming.
